summary: The change fixes the cause the user reported. The producer brief built by `producer_brief` in crates/athena-context/src/briefs.rs now has a "What the verifier sees" section. It says the verifier sees only the candidate diff in a fresh snapshot, and that evidence must cite commands the verifier can run itself, so the producer's own git status and git diff runs do not count. It also says commit hashes made during verification do not exist in the real history and must never be pinned or cited in code, docs, or design-revision text, BRIEF.md included. A regression test, `producer_briefs_say_what_the_verifier_can_see`, checks for each of these phrases. It would fail on the base commit, which has none of this text. I did not run it on base. The D43 gate in verify.rs is unchanged. New decision D62 in docs/decisions.md records the cause and the fix. I ran `cargo test`, `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` and `cargo fmt --all --check`, and all were clean, including the new test and the context-budget tests. One minor gap: CHANGELOG.md has no entry, although it was an expected deliverable and the project records notable changes there.
